title: Wizard
description: Fiori wizard: step tabs (number or icon, title, subtitle, separators) over scrolling step contents; keyboard tab navigation, scroll-to-step, disabled future steps, collapsed step stacks (ui5-wizard).

usage.summary: Guide users through a task in reachable steps inside an existing page or custom workflow.
useWhen: Help users complete a complex task by dividing it into guided steps; a wizard page typically has 3–8 steps.
Let users revisit reached steps while the application keeps unreached steps disabled until their prerequisites are met.
Use contentLayout="multipleSteps" to stack reached sections or "singleStep" to show only the selected section.

avoidWhen.when: Start from a complete page with step validation, footer actions and a review/submit screen.
Edit fields together without needing a guided step sequence.
Browse independent content facets without controlling task progress.
Narrow a result collection by filter criteria rather than complete a guided task.
Trigger a standalone action without collecting inputs or tracking task steps.
